name: Invoice 4
definition: Invoice data pertaining to the payment transaction.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Contains the date and time the electronic invoice was created.

SummaryCommodityIdentification.name: Summary Commodity Identification
SummaryCommodityIdentification.definition: Provides the identifier assigned by the card acceptor that best categorizes the items being purchased in a standardized commodity group.

SellerLegalCorporateName.name: Seller Legal Corporate Name
SellerLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the seller.

SellerLocalData.name: Seller Local Data
SellerLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of seller data.

SellerContact.name: Seller Contact
SellerContact.definition: Contact information related to the seller.

SellerTaxRegistrationIdentification.name: Seller Tax Registration Identification
SellerTaxRegistrationIdentification.definition: Identification of the seller recognized by the taxation authority.

BuyerLegalCorporateName.name: Buyer Legal Corporate Name
BuyerLegalCorporateName.definition: Legal Corporate Name of the buyer.

BuyerLocalData.name: Buyer Local Data
BuyerLocalData.definition: Contains local language equivalent(s) of buyer data.

BuyerContact.name: Buyer Contact
BuyerContact.definition: Contact information related to the buyer.

BuyerTaxRegistrationIdentification.name: Buyer Tax Registration Identification
BuyerTaxRegistrationIdentification.definition: Identification of the buyer recognized by the taxation authority.

FreightAmount.name: Freight Amount
FreightAmount.definition: Contains the freight charges for the entire purchase.

TaxTotal.name: Tax Total
TaxTotal.definition: Contains the total tax amount for the entire purchase.

TaxReclaimMethod.name: Tax Reclaim Method
TaxReclaimMethod.definition: Code that identifies the disposition of the tax reclaim invoice.

PrivateData.name: Private Data
PrivateData.definition: Reserved for private data. The use of this data element is determined by bilateral agreement.

NationalData.name: National Data
NationalData.definition: Reserved to define data unique to the country applications.
